source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(          ORDER BY x.SBSB_ID     ) AS RowNumber,      x.SBSB_ID,      x.GRGR_ID,      x.CSCS_ID,      x.BLDF_EFF_DT,      x.BLDF_TERM_DT FROM (      SELECT DISTINCT         sbsb.SBSB_ID,         grgr.GRGR_ID,         mepe.CSCS_ID,         bldf.BLDF_EFF_DT,         bldf.BLDF_TERM_DT                                                      FROM CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe     INNER JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER meme         ON mepe.MEME_CK = meme.MEME_CK     INNER JOIN CMC_SBSB_SUBSC sbsb       ON meme.SBSB_CK = sbsb.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP grgr       ON sbsb.GRGR_CK = grgr.GRGR_CK     INNER JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO blei       ON sbsb.SBSB_CK = blei.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK     INNER JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE bldf       ON blei.BLEI_CK = bldf.BLEI_CK     WHERE (          (             mepe.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'                 AND TO_DATE ('06/07/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN mepe.MEPE_EFF_DT AND mepe.MEPE_TERM_DT          )         AND         (             bldf.BLDF_MCTR_STMT = 'EFT'                 AND TO_DATE ('06/07/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN bldf.BLDF_EFF_DT AND bldf.BLDF_TERM_DT         )     )         AND (              grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUPWP0'                 OR grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP000'         ) ) x

SELECT      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(          ORDER BY x.SBSB_ID     ) AS RowNumber,      x.SBSB_ID,      x.GRGR_ID,      x.CSCS_ID,      x.BLDF_EFF_DT,      x.BLDF_TERM_DT FROM (      SELECT DISTINCT         sbsb.SBSB_ID,         grgr.GRGR_ID,         mepe.CSCS_ID,         bldf.BLDF_EFF_DT,         bldf.BLDF_TERM_DT                                                      FROM CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe     INNER JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER meme         ON mepe.MEME_CK = meme.MEME_CK     INNER JOIN CMC_SBSB_SUBSC sbsb       ON meme.SBSB_CK = sbsb.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP grgr       ON sbsb.GRGR_CK = grgr.GRGR_CK     INNER JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO blei       ON sbsb.SBSB_CK = blei.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK     INNER JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE bldf       ON blei.BLEI_CK = bldf.BLEI_CK     WHERE (          (             mepe.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'                 AND TO_DATE ('06/07/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN mepe.MEPE_EFF_DT AND mepe.MEPE_TERM_DT          )         AND         (             bldf.BLDF_MCTR_STMT = 'EFT'                 AND TO_DATE ('06/07/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN bldf.BLDF_EFF_DT AND bldf.BLDF_TERM_DT         )     )         AND (              grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUPWP0'                 OR grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP000'         ) ) x

'CREATE TABLE `Sheet1` (
    `SBSB_ID` LongText,
    `GRGR_ID` LongText,
    `CSCS_ID` LongText,
    `BLDF_EFF_DT` DateTime,
    `BLDF_TERM_DT` DateTime
)'

PDPSql.defaultValue: 'SELECT ROW_NUMBER () OVER (ORDER BY SBSB_ID ASC) AS RowNumber, SBSB.SBSB_ID, GRGR.GRGR_ID, MEPE.CSCS_ID, BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT, BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%PDP%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%EGR%') INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK AND SBSB.GRGR_CK = MEME.GRGR_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE ('01/11/2021', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK AND TO_DATE ('01/11/2021', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT IN ('EFT')'

MedSuppSql.defaultValue:
'SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER( 
        ORDER BY x.SBSB_ID
    ) AS RowNumber, 
    x.SBSB_ID, 
    x.GRGR_ID, 
    x.CSCS_ID, 
    x.BLDF_EFF_DT, 
    x.BLDF_TERM_DT
FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT  
    SBSB.SBSB_ID,
    GRGR.GRGR_ID,
    MEPE.CSCS_ID,
    BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT,
    BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT 
    
FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB

INNER JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
    ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
    AND GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'
       
INNER JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
    ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK
    AND SBSB.GRGR_CK = MEME.GRGR_CK
    
INNER JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
    ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
    AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' 
    AND TO_DATE ('01/11/2021', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE_TERM_DT 

INNER JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
    ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
    AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'
   
INNER JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF
    ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK
    AND TO_DATE ('01/11/2021', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT 
    AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT IN ('EFT') ) x'
